'''September 2000 Amsterdam tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Amsterdam, Netherlands on 3 September 2000. It is known from Maarten Rossou's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1202">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-05-amsterdam-the-netherlands-030900d1202/ amsterdam-the-netherlands-030900], DeckTech (Maarten "PIET" Rossou, 5 September 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-05-amsterdam-the-netherlands-030900d1202/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 3 September 2000
* '''Site:''' Amsterdam, Netherlands
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Players:''' 18
